headline: ALMT Legal advises Okintek Capital on investment in Clinevo Technologies
sum: Okintek Capital LLC, led by Rehan Netarwala, has made an investment in Clinevo Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
detail: Okintek Capital LLC, led by Rehan Netarwala, has made an investment in Clinevo Technologies Pvt. Ltd. The transaction was structured as a two-step investment, with an initial capital infusion into Okintek India by, inter alios, Ambit Partners, Lighthaven and Okintek Capital LLC, followed by Okintek India's investment in Clinevo Technologies. ALMT Legal, Bengaluru represented Okintek Capital and Rehan Netarwala on this transaction.
